title: BECE Basic Science - Basic Science - Environmental Hazards
subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Soil erosion is best defined as:
options: The formation of soil from rocks
The washing away of the topsoil
The planting of crops on ridges
The addition of manure to soil
questions.explain: Erosion is the displacement or washing away of the upper layer of soil by agents like water or wind.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which of these human activities contributes most to flooding in urban areas?
questions.explain: Blocked drainage channels prevent water flow, leading to flooding during heavy rains.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: One method of controlling soil erosion is:
questions.explain: Cover crops protect the soil surface from the direct impact of rain and hold the soil together with their roots.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The depletion of the Ozone layer is mainly caused by:
questions.explain: CFCs are industrial chemicals that rise into the stratosphere and break down ozone molecules.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Bush burning results in the loss of:
questions.explain: Burning bushes destroys habitats, killing plants and animals or forcing them to migrate, thus reducing biodiversity.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: The Ozone layer protects living things on Earth from:
questions.explain: The Ozone layer absorbs the majority of the sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.explain: Removing trees exposes the land to drying out and erosion, which can eventually transform fertile land into desert (desertification).
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Which agency in Nigeria is responsible for emergency responses to hazards like flooding?
questions.explain: NEMA (National Emergency Management Agency) handles disaster management in Nigeria.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: Gully erosion is most commonly caused by:
questions.explain: Gully erosion occurs when runoff water accumulates in narrow channels and removes soil to a considerable depth.
questions.subject: Basic Science

questions.q: A major health risk associated with Ozone layer depletion is:
questions.explain: Increased exposure to UV radiation due to ozone depletion increases the risk of skin cancer and cataracts.
questions.subject: Basic Science
